caption: Create empty lots to fill spaces where roads cannot pass.
content: Once you have all the empty-lot corner tiles @t{forest_open.1.dr} @t{forest_open.1.dl} @t{forest_open.1.ul} @t{forest_open.1.ur}, you can create empty lots.
When you can only create roads and empty lots, @b{any space where a road cannot pass must be filled with an empty lot}.

content.caption: Example
content: Assuming your available tiles are @t{forest_road.2s.lr} @t{forest_road.2t.dr} @t{forest_open.1.dr} and their rotations, let's solve this Area.
If we focus on the cell @m{pending}, either @t{forest_road.2t.ur} or @t{forest_open.1.ur} can be placed here.
If you place @t{forest_road.2t.ur}, the road cannot get past the narrow section @m{unsatisfied}, making it impossible to @g{rule/complete_block/road}{connect all roads into a single network}.
Therefore, you have to place an empty-lot tile on the cell @m{pending} and create an empty lot as shown.
Similarly, a road cannot pass through the cell @m{pending}, so you have to create an empty lot there as well.
The remaining cells can be filled with roads, completing the Area as shown.
